correctness.rationale: With a_i,b_i the two arm signs and s the center sign, partitioning the nonempty induced connected sets by center membership gives multiplier s·∏(1+a_i+a_i b_i)+∑(a_i+b_i+a_i b_i). The all-positive arm contributes (3,3) to the local product and sum; other arms contribute a unit sign and −1. Thus each branch 4j−m±3^j occurs with multiplicity binomial(m,j)3^(m−j), counting collisions additively. The minus branch has no zeros for m≥2 since 4j−3^j≤1. The plus branch vanishes only at the unique index r with m=4r+3^r. Its closest nonzero value is the preceding increment 4+2·3^(r−1); the minus branch has magnitude at least m−1, which is no smaller. Unitary character diagonalization gives the nullity, rank and reciprocal pseudoinverse gap; the trivial multiplier 3^m+3m is maximal in magnitude by the triangle inequality. At m=7 this gives 5103 zeros, rank 27665, gap 6 and ratio 2208/6=368. For the excluded m=1 there are four zeros.
